name: StockWallpapers
tagline: 在 iOS 16–18 体验多代系统壁纸与动态效果。
notice: 支持 iOS 16–18。部分画面、动态细节、横屏及强制 iPad 模式仍在适配。全量“刷新收藏夹”可能移除额外项目并影响相关已保存壁纸，请先保留需要的原始素材。 卸载按常规执行；需要清理本插件收藏入口时请先在设置内手动删除。卸载后不再提供本插件动态效果。
description: 将 iOS 18、26、27 的多款系统壁纸接入系统墙纸图库，在各自系列内切换款式。
iOS 16／17 提供 9 个系列、42 款；iOS 18 提供 8 个移植系列、37 款，保留系统原有 Fluidity，并在安装后移除本插件的重复资源。
features: Pride Luminance：11 款；Fluidity（iOS 18 系列）：5 款，仅在 iOS 16／17 提供移植版本；Space（iOS 26）：5 款。
Celosia：3 款；Flocon：3 款；Jurin：4 款。
Vitra：4 款；Marble：5 款；V68：2 款。款式在各自系列内切换。
支持各系列已适配的解锁、唤醒、明暗和动态效果，具体效果依系列而异。
浅色／深色／自动外观选项：Space、Celosia、V68及移植版Fluidity，选择保存到当前壁纸。
景深效果选项：Space（仅手机模式）、Celosia、Vitra、V68及移植版Fluidity；移植版Fluidity仅在iOS16／17提供。
统一启用开关、Celosia 自选颜色、收藏夹管理、精简诊断摘要与完整日志导出。
设置名称与文案支持简体中文、繁体中文和英文。
“清理收藏夹”提供素材预览、占用估算与勾选确认，保护已保存壁纸使用的项目；引用无法核实时禁止清理。
列表刷新仅查看现有内容；全量“刷新收藏夹”须确认后执行，不会自动触发。
卸载按系统常规执行，不额外清理收藏入口；手动删除仍在插件设置中提供。
“管理本插件壁纸”提供收藏缓存预览，可单独或批量移除本插件入口，保留已保存／当前配置和本机原素材。
可恢复已移除的本插件入口，无需重新下载素材；恢复前须确认全量刷新提示。
诊断默认复制精简摘要，也可导出完整日志文件。
compatibility: Rootless／RootHide 各提供一个统一安装包，按当前越狱环境选择；需要 PreferenceLoader 及可加载系统插件的越狱环境。
按系统适配壁纸显示、款式选择与动态效果；iOS 18 不重复安装移植版 Fluidity。
不同设备、系统小版本与横屏／强制 iPad 模式的表现可能不同。
usage: 在 iOS 16／17／18 按越狱环境安装 Rootless 或 RootHide 包，并按包管理器提示完成必要的环境重新加载。
进入“设置 → 系统壁纸”，确认“启用实时壁纸”已打开。
进入“设置 → 墙纸 → 添加新墙纸 → 收藏”查找系列。收藏缩略图可能不显示系列名称，点入预览后切换款式。
在支持系列的编辑页选择外观或景深，点“完成”保存；取消编辑不会覆盖原选择。V68手动切换款式会退出自动外观。
切换系统外观后，部分预览可能需要退出编辑页再重新进入刷新；无需删除或重新添加壁纸。
景深遵循系统小组件限制，遮挡效果取决于壁纸与时钟的重叠区域。
安装或更新后入口可能稍后出现。先稍候，退出“添加新墙纸”页面，再重新进入；只停留在旧页面可能仍看到缓存列表。
仍未出现时，在插件设置的“收藏夹管理”中点“重新加载壁纸进程”，再点“打开 PosterBoard”；打开后从 App 切换器划掉，再重新进入添加页面。
无需为刷新入口先删除已设置的壁纸。若仍异常，先打开一次“添加新墙纸”，返回插件的“诊断日志”点“刷新”，复制精简摘要，或导出完整日志文件，并提供具体系列、iOS 版本、越狱环境和异常界面。
清理前先打开一次“添加新墙纸”，再回到插件设置 → 清理收藏夹，核对预览、标识与占用，勾选需要移除的项目后确认。未选项目和被保存配置使用的项目予以保留；大小为估算，不保证全部可释放。
“刷新列表”仅读取现有内容。仅在确需全量更新时使用“刷新收藏夹”，先阅读并确认风险；额外收藏项目及相关已保存壁纸配置可能受影响。
更新后完全退出“设置”再打开，先使用“重新加载壁纸进程”，再打开一次“添加新墙纸”激活新功能。
在“设置 → 系统壁纸 → 管理本插件壁纸”直接查看本机收藏缓存与缩略图，查看列表无需先打开墙纸图库。勾选系列并确认，可移除单项或全部本插件入口；按需结束壁纸进程，保留已保存／当前配置、原素材和其他项目。
需要恢复时点“恢复已移除的入口”，阅读全量刷新风险并确认；随后会打开墙纸图库，完成后返回管理页查看结果。
如使用Lite测试版，请先卸载Lite，再直接升级完整版0.2.0；不要先卸载完整版，已有壁纸无需重新添加。
曾在0.1.4卸载失败的用户可直接升级0.2.0，再正常卸载。如需清理收藏入口，请在卸载前使用管理页手动处理；卸载本身不额外清理收藏。

changes: 修复壁纸管理列表为空及移除无效的问题，支持预览并单独或批量移除收藏入口。
新增恢复已移除入口，无需重新下载壁纸素材；移除时保留已保存和当前壁纸配置。
诊断默认复制精简摘要，支持导出完整日志，便于反馈问题。
恢复常规卸载，修复壁纸清理校验导致卸载失败的问题。
保留设置中的手动删除功能；需要清理收藏入口时，请在卸载前处理。
已安装 0.1.4 的用户可直接升级此修订版，再正常卸载；已保存和当前壁纸配置保留。
新增“删除本插件壁纸”，支持勾选系列或批量移除全部收藏入口。
卸载时自动清理本插件剩余收藏入口；升级不会执行清理。
仅移除收藏入口，保留已保存和当前使用的壁纸配置，以及其他来源项目。
修复打开图库时额外收藏项目可能意外消失的问题。
新增“清理收藏夹”，支持预览、占用估算和勾选确认，保护已保存壁纸使用的项目。
新增需确认的“刷新收藏夹”，区分列表查看与全量刷新。
新增支持系列的浅色、深色与自动外观选项，选择随单张壁纸保存。
补齐支持系列的景深效果控制，改善前景遮挡与保存后的显示。
优化 V68 外观选项与款式切换联动，保留已有壁纸配置。
支持 iOS 16–18，按系统自动适配；暂不支持 iOS 15。
iOS 16／17 提供 9 系列 42 款，iOS 18 提供 8 系列 37 款，并移除重复的 Fluidity 资源。
适配 iOS 16 款式选择与 iOS 18 图库显示，更新安装及入口刷新说明。
提供9个系列、42种系统壁纸样式，包含iOS 18、26、27的壁纸，当前仅支持iOS 17.x。
优化图库显示与动态恢复，修复入口缺失及反复下拉通知后停止动画的问题。
精简设置并加入图库刷新与诊断，支持简体中文、繁体中文和英文名称及文案。

en.name: StockWallpapers
en.tagline: Enjoy stock wallpaper families and animations on iOS 16–18.
en.notice: Supports iOS 16–18. Some visuals, animation details, landscape behavior and forced iPad mode remain under adaptation. A full Refresh Collections may remove additional items and affect related saved wallpapers. Keep the original materials you need before proceeding. Uninstall follows the normal system process. Remove owned Collections entries manually in Settings first if needed. Tweak-provided animation is no longer available after uninstall.
description: Brings selected stock wallpapers from iOS 18, 26 and 27 into the system wallpaper gallery, with looks grouped within each family.

iOS 16 and 17 include 9 families and 42 looks. iOS 18 includes 8 ported families and 37 looks, keeps the system Fluidity family, and removes this package’s duplicate Fluidity resources after installation.
features: Pride Luminance: 11 looks; Fluidity (iOS 18 family): 5, ported only on iOS 16/17; Space (iOS 26): 5.
Celosia: 3 looks; Flocon: 3; Jurin: 4.
Vitra: 4 looks; Marble: 5; V68: 2. Select looks within their respective families.
Supported unlock, wake, appearance and animation effects vary by family.
Light, Dark and Automatic appearance options for Space, Celosia, V68 and ported Fluidity, saved per wallpaper.
Depth Effect options for Space (phone mode only), Celosia, Vitra, V68 and ported Fluidity. Ported Fluidity is available only on iOS 16/17.
One enable switch, custom Celosia color, Collections management, compact diagnostic summaries and full log export.
Settings names and text in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English.
Clean Up Collections offers source previews, estimated storage and selection confirmation, protecting items used by saved wallpapers. Unverifiable references are protected.
List refresh reads existing content. A full Refresh Collections runs only after confirmation and never starts automatically.
Uninstall follows the normal system process without additional gallery cleanup; manual entry removal remains available in Settings.
Manage StockWallpapers Entries shows cached previews and offers individual or bulk entry removal, keeping saved/current configurations and installed original resources.
Restore removed StockWallpapers entries without downloading resources again; restoration requires confirmation of a full refresh.
Copy compact diagnostic summaries or export the complete log as a file.
compatibility: One unified package for Rootless and one for RootHide; choose the package matching your jailbreak. Requires PreferenceLoader and a jailbreak environment that loads system tweaks.
Wallpaper display, look selection and animation are adapted by system version; iOS 18 does not install a duplicate ported Fluidity family.
Behavior may vary by device, minor OS version, landscape orientation and forced iPad mode.
usage: On iOS 16, 17 or 18, install the Rootless or RootHide package matching your jailbreak, and complete any environment reload requested by the package manager.
Open Settings → StockWallpapers and confirm Enable Live Wallpapers is on.
Find families in Settings → Wallpaper → Add New Wallpaper → Collections. Thumbnails may not show family names; open a preview to switch looks.
Choose appearance or Depth Effect in a supported family and tap Done to save; cancelling keeps your previous selection. Manually switching V68 looks exits Automatic appearance.
After changing system appearance, some previews may need to be closed and reopened to refresh. You do not need to delete or recreate the wallpaper.
Depth Effect follows system widget restrictions and depends on overlap between the wallpaper and clock.
Entries may appear after a delay. Wait briefly, leave Add New Wallpaper and reopen it; a page left open may retain its cached list.

If entries remain missing, open Collections Management in this tweak’s Settings, tap Reload Wallpaper Processes, then Open PosterBoard. Swipe PosterBoard away in the app switcher and reopen Add New Wallpaper.

You do not need to delete an existing wallpaper to refresh the gallery. If a problem remains, open Add New Wallpaper once, return to Diagnostic Log, tap Refresh and copy the compact summary or export the full log. Include the family, iOS version, jailbreak environment and affected screen.

Before cleanup, open Add New Wallpaper once, then return to Settings → StockWallpapers → Clean Up Collections. Check previews, identifiers and storage, select items and confirm. Unselected items and items used by saved configurations are kept. Storage is an estimate, not guaranteed recovered space.

Refresh List only reads existing content. Use Refresh Collections only when a full update is needed and after reading its confirmation warning; additional items and related saved configurations may be affected.
After updating, close Settings from the app switcher and reopen it. Use Reload Wallpaper Processes, then open Add New Wallpaper once to activate the new code.

Open Settings → StockWallpapers → Manage StockWallpapers Entries to view the local Collections cache and thumbnails directly. Viewing the list does not require opening the wallpaper gallery first. Select families and confirm individual or bulk entry removal. Wallpaper processes stop if needed; saved/current configurations, original resources and other entries are kept.
To restore entries, choose Restore Removed Entries and confirm the full-refresh warning. The wallpaper gallery then opens; return to the manager afterward to check the result.
If you use a Lite test package, remove Lite before upgrading the full package to 0.2.0. Do not uninstall the full package first. Existing wallpapers do not need to be recreated.

Users whose 0.1.4 uninstall failed can upgrade directly to 0.2.0, then uninstall normally. Use the manager before uninstalling if entry cleanup is needed; uninstall itself does not additionally clean Collections.

changes: Fixes the empty wallpaper manager and ineffective removal, with previews and individual or bulk entry removal.
Adds restoration of removed entries without downloading wallpaper resources again; removal keeps saved and current configurations.
Copies a compact diagnostic summary by default and supports exporting the complete log.
Restores normal uninstall and fixes removal being blocked by wallpaper cleanup validation.
Keeps manual entry removal in Settings; clean Collections entries before uninstalling if needed.
Users on 0.1.4 can upgrade directly to this revision, then uninstall normally. Saved and current wallpaper configurations are kept.
Adds Remove StockWallpapers Entries, with family selection or removal of all owned Collections entries.
Automatically cleans remaining StockWallpapers entries during uninstall; upgrades do not clean the gallery.
Removes gallery entries only, keeping saved and current wallpaper configurations and other sources.
Fixes additional Collections items disappearing when opening the wallpaper gallery.
Adds Clean Up Collections with previews, estimated storage and selection confirmation, protecting items used by saved wallpapers.
Adds confirmation for Refresh Collections and separates list refresh from a full catalog refresh.
Adds Light, Dark and Automatic appearance options for supported families, saved per wallpaper.
Adds Depth Effect controls for supported families and improves foreground and saved wallpaper display.
Improves V68 appearance and look selection while preserving existing wallpaper configurations.
Supports iOS 16–18 with system-specific adaptation; iOS 15 remains unsupported.
Includes 9 families and 42 looks on iOS 16/17, or 8 families and 37 looks on iOS 18 without duplicate Fluidity resources.
Adapts look selection on iOS 16 and gallery visibility on iOS 18, with updated installation and gallery-refresh instructions.
Adds 42 wallpaper looks across 9 families from iOS 18, 26 and 27; iOS 17.x only.
Improves gallery visibility and animation recovery, including missing entries and animations stopping after repeated Notification Center pulls.
Streamlines Settings with gallery refresh and diagnostics, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English names and text.
